hook.en: Over a few years a firm can build a bigger factory or move to a smaller one. Then no cost is fixed, and the size of the firm decides its average cost.
hook.kn: ಕೆಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು. ಆಗ ಯಾವ ವೆಚ್ಚವೂ ಸ್ಥಿರವಲ್ಲ; ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಗಾತ್ರವೇ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the U-shape of LRAC through returns to scale

narration.en: Over a few years a firm can build a bigger factory or move to a smaller one. Then no cost is fixed, and the size of the firm decides its average cost.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು. ಆಗ ಯಾವ ವೆಚ್ಚವೂ ಸ್ಥಿರವಲ್ಲ; ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಗಾತ್ರವೇ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: In the long run all inputs are variable, so there are no fixed costs: total cost and total variable cost are the same. Long-run average cost $LRAC = TC/q$ and long-run marginal cost $LRMC = \Delta TC/\Delta q$. The LRAC curve is U-shaped: it falls while the firm enjoys increasing returns to scale, is flat over constant returns, and rises when decreasing returns set in.

points.en: No fixed cost in the long run

narration.en: In the long run there are no fixed costs. The long-run average cost curve is U-shaped because of returns to scale.
narration.kn: ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳಿಲ್ಲ. ಪ್ರಮಾಣದ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲದ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದ ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ U ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

say.en: Here are LRAC and LRMC. LRAC falls, reaches its lowest point at an output of 4, then rises.
Below 4 units, the firm has increasing returns, so LRAC falls. Beyond 4, decreasing returns push it up.
LRMC is below LRAC while LRAC falls and above it while LRAC rises, so it cuts LRAC at the minimum.

narration.en: Here are LRAC and LRMC. LRAC falls, reaches its lowest point at an output of 4, then rises.

body.en: Like short-run curves, LRMC is U-shaped. When LRMC is below LRAC, LRAC falls; when LRMC is above LRAC, LRAC rises; LRMC cuts LRAC from below at its minimum point. Because of increasing returns to scale, larger firms in many industries (steel, cement, power) can produce at a lower average cost.

narration.en: LRMC is below LRAC when LRAC falls and above it when LRAC rises, so LRMC cuts LRAC at its minimum.
narration.kn: ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಇಳಿಯುವಾಗ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕೆಳಗೆ, ಏರುವಾಗ ಮೇಲೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದರ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಛೇದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A firm spends ₹1,000 to produce 100 units. In the long run it doubles all inputs; total cost rises to ₹2,000 and output to 300 units. Find LRAC before and after and name the returns to scale.

steps.en: Inputs doubled, output tripled: increasing returns to scale, so LRAC falls.

answer.en: LRAC falls from ₹10 to about ₹6.67: increasing returns to scale.
